message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common “tools” (websites, apps, APIs, and platforms) you can use to book flights, whether you’re a casual traveler, a travel agent, or a developer building a travel‑booking solution.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it offers | Typical use‑case |
|----------|----------------|----------------|-----------------|
| **Consumer flight search & booking** | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price alerts, multi‑city itineraries | Quick price comparison & booking |
| | **Skyscanner** | Aggregates fares from airlines & OTAs, price alerts, “Everywhere” search | Budget travelers, flexible dates |
| | **Kayak** | Price comparison, price alerts, “Explore” feature | All‑rounder, multi‑segment trips |
| | **Momondo** | Aggregates fares, shows price history, “Price calendar” | Price‑sensitive travelers |
| | **Expedia** | Flights + hotels + car rentals, package deals | One‑stop booking for multi‑service trips |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price”, “Express Deals” | Last‑minute deals, budget bookings |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, often bundled with hotel points | Frequent traveler programs |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, price alerts, mobile app | Mobile‑first travelers, price prediction |
| | **Trip.com / Ctrip** | Strong presence in Asia, multi‑currency support | International travelers, Asian routes |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not a flight tool, but often bundled with travel packages | Experiential travel |
| | **Airline direct sites** (e.g., Delta, United, Lufthansa) | Lowest fare guarantee, loyalty points | Loyalty program members |
| | **Mobile apps** (e.g., Hopper, Skyscanner, Google Flights) | On‑the‑go booking, push notifications | Travelers who prefer smartphones |
| **Developer APIs / SDKs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, availability, pricing, seat maps | Build custom booking engines |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Comprehensive travel data, booking, inventory | Enterprise travel agencies |
| | **Travelport APIs** | Global distribution system (GDS) access | Large‑scale travel agencies |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search, price alerts, flight data | Integrate flight search into apps |
| | **Google Flights API** (via Google Travel) | Flight search, price trends | Data‑driven travel analytics |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, historical data | Tracking & monitoring flights |
| | **OpenSky Network API** | Real‑time flight data, ADS‑B feeds | Aviation enthusiasts, research |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, historical data | Customer support, travel apps |
| | **AirLabs API** | Flight search, airline data, airport info | Travel tech startups |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** | Live flight tracking | Real‑time flight monitoring |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate flight booking, price comparison | Affiliate marketing, travel blogs |
| | **Skiplagged API** | Hidden‑city flight search | Price‑optimizing travelers |
| **Travel agencies / GDS** | **Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport** | Global distribution, booking, inventory | Corporate travel, large agencies |
| | **Concorde Travel** | GDS integration, booking tools | Small to mid‑size agencies |
| | **Travelport Universal API** | Unified interface to multiple GDS | Multi‑channel booking |
| **Other tools** | **FlightAware Flight Status** | Real‑time flight tracking, alerts | Customer service, travel apps |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Live flight tracking, historical data | Aviation enthusiasts |
| | **FlightStats** | Flight status, delay predictions | Travel apps, airline ops |
| | **OpenFlights** | Open‑source flight data | Research, hobby projects |

### How to choose the right tool

| Need | Recommended tool(s) |
|------|--------------------|
| **Quick price comparison & booking** | Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak, Momondo |
| **Last‑minute deals** | Priceline, Hopper, Expedia |
| **Multi‑service packages (flight + hotel + car)** | Expedia, Orbitz, Priceline |
| **Mobile‑first booking** | Hopper, Skyscanner, Google Flights |
| **Custom booking engine** | Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport |
| **Affiliate marketing** | Travelpayouts, Skyscanner Affiliate |
| **Real‑time flight tracking** | FlightAware, FlightRadar24 |
| **Data analytics / price prediction** | Hopper, Amadeus, Skyscanner API |
| **International focus (Asia)** | Trip.com, Ctrip |
| **Budget & flexible dates** | Skyscanner “Everywhere”, Momondo |

---

#### Quick Tips

1. **Use multiple aggregators** – Prices can vary between sites; a quick cross‑check often reveals cheaper options.
2. **Set price alerts** – Most aggregators (Google Flights, Skyscanner, Hopper) let you track fares and notify you when prices drop.
3. **Book directly with airlines** – After finding the best fare, check the airline’s own site; they sometimes offer lower prices or better cancellation policies.
4. **Check for hidden fees** – Some OTAs add baggage or seat‑selection fees; airlines may charge less for those extras.
5. **Leverage loyalty programs** – If you fly frequently, book directly with the airline to earn miles or points.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like deeper details on any specific platform, or if you’re looking for code snippets to integrate a particular API!
